content.text:
Perfect! All 76 tests pass. I've added invoice rendering functionality:

**New module: src/render.js**

**`renderInvoiceText(invoice)`** — Renders an invoice as plain text for customers:
- First line: Invoice number (or "DRAFT" if it has none)
- Second line: Customer's name (looked up from customers module, falls back to customerId if not found)
- Empty line
- One line per invoice item showing: `<qty>x <name> @ <unit price> = <line total>`
- Empty line
- Last line: `Total: <total amount>`

**Key features:**
- All monetary amounts use `formatEuros()` for consistent customer-facing formatting
- Handles quantity display (singular "1x" vs plural "2x")
- Works with multiple line items and different VAT rates
- Gracefully handles customer lookup failures

**Test coverage:**

Added 13 comprehensive tests covering:
- Draft (DRAFT) vs issued invoices (with number)
- Customer name lookup and fallback to customerId
- Single and multiple line items
- Quantity formatting
- Proper use of formatEuros for all amounts
- Large amounts and thousands separators
- VAT-exempt items
- Output structure (multiline string)

All 76 tests pass ✅
